name: lutris (runtime)
description: Lutris has a runtime-component update channel. The inspected component performs a basic non-empty-content check, which is not publisher authentication; the broader verification policy remains unestablished.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; release-specific behavior and external TLS/framework enforcement were not independently audited.
